text:
𝗕𝗨𝗠𝗥𝗔𝗛 𝗝𝗢𝗜𝗡𝗧-𝟮𝗡𝗗! 🔥🇮🇳

After 5 wickets in the first Test v NZ, Bumrah climbs 3 places in the ICC Test rankings.
He's 25 rating points behind No.1 Starc.

Can he catch him? 👇
#TeamIndia #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗕𝗨𝗠𝗥𝗔𝗛 𝗔𝗕 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧 𝗥𝗔𝗡𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗡𝗢.𝟮! 🔥🇮🇳

👉 NZ ke khilaf pehle Test mein 5 wicket ke baad 3 sthaan upar
👉 Ab Ollie Robinson ke saath joint-second
👉 No.1 Mitchell Starc se sirf 25 rating points peeche
👉 Rabada bhi 2 sthaan upar, ab 6th

Kya Bumrah jaldi No.1 banenge? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #Bumrah #TeamIndia
